description:
Create or update (upsert) a local workspace: a named set of dashboard widgets stored in /tmp/churn-n3cvb6uh/.config/appmetrica-mcp/workspaces.json. Local file operation only — nothing is written to AppMetrica, so it is not gated by APPMETRICA_ALLOW_WRITE.
Each widget has a name and exactly one of: preset (audience, installs, installs_by_country, engagement, app_versions, events, crashes, errors, anr, revenue, ad_revenue, ad_revenue_by_type, conversions, traffic, push, funnels, retention), metrics (custom, single namespace; optional dimensions/filters/segment_id/limit) or funnel_id (saved funnel). Use it later via get_dashboard(workspace=name).

dimensions.description: Breakdown dimensions (full keys or bare suffixes of the metrics namespace)

metrics.description: Custom widget: metric keys of a single namespace

name: save_workspace
